title: Actuator & Micrometer Metrics in Spring Boot

scenes.line1: How do you monitor your app?
scenes.say: Ever wondered how to track your Spring Boot app’s health and performance in production?

scenes.label: Actuator
scenes.sub: Exposes endpoints for health, metrics, and info.
scenes.say: Actuator gives you built-in endpoints for health checks, metrics, and app info.
Micrometer works with Actuator to export metrics to tools like Prometheus, so you can monitor your app externally.
You can customize health checks to include your database, disk space, or anything else you need.

scenes.question: How do you expose Actuator endpoints?
scenes.right: Set endpoint exposure in settings to choose which endpoints are available.
scenes.say: Don’t forget, you need to configure which endpoints are actually exposed, not just add Actuator.
